Results.ReviewText: I have tried gas grills and pellet grills.  While each one has their advantage in convenience and ease of use, that real grilled flavor I want only comes from charcoal.  The Weber Original does charcoal the best.  It’s well thought out and we’ll made.
Results.Title: It’s a classic for a reason

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Original is well built and easy to use. Whether your new to barbecuing or your a seasoned barbecue vet, this grill is for you. I am very happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Weber Original

Results.ReviewText: My first cook I smoked a brisket with the snake method. It turned out great. Loving my new kettle.
Results.Title: Great Versatile Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
We're glad to hear that you're enjoying your 22" Original Kettle Premium, and will be happy to pass along your feedback to our Charcoal Product Management team. 

Regarding the points you mentioned, while moving the lid from the closed to open position by using the hook, rotating the lid 90 degrees and hanging the lid over the side of the kettle can improve the ergonomics of the procedure. 

As for the thermometer placement, while the thermometer is just a general guide of the ambient temperature at the top of the kettle lid, briefly rotating the lid to gauge the heat being generated underneath can typically help. 

Lastly, as for the placement of the lid vent over the food you're cooking, we actually do not make any assertions that it must be placed directly over the food you're cooking, as the impact to the thermal dynamics in the kettle are minor, since convective heat is one of the hallmarks of how our kettles operate. All that said, we highly value feedback from our grill owners like you, and will be happy to pass yours along.

Our Care team would like to know more about your experience. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Overall, the grill is built very nice. The location of the lid hanger hook as compared to the handle on top is awkward. It should be placed in line with the lid handle, instead of being at 90° like the old style used to be. Also, the placement of the thermometer should be located near the lid vent, instead of 180°, so that it is not directly over the coals when grilling with the indirect method. Everyone knows that the lid vent is supposed to be over the meat and not the coals when grilling/smoking indirect.
Results.Title: Could use some improvements.

Results.ReviewText: Had one years ago and you can't beat the great taste.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Nice size and convenient features make this a good upgrade to my previous weber. The thermometer, heat guard on the handle, ash catcher, and flip up grill surface are all brilliantly simple improvements. Even the utensil hooks on the handle make my life easier without over-complicating the product.
Results.Title: Simple, but with clever features

Results.ReviewText: Great little charcoal grill.  Bought it to pair with my E310
Results.Title: Can't beat the classic.

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Chicken wings and legs are my favorite. With the 22" Premium grill and a vortex, for indirect cooking , my chicken comes out  perfect. ( not my only Weber, nor my last.)
Results.Title: Weber, best grills ever.

Results.ReviewText: This grill males a great gift: Easy to build, use, and clean
Results.Title: First time grill owner.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble thanks to good instructions & parts labeling. Stupid easy to use; nearly idiot proof. Only real detractors being the lid vent control doesn't have heat protection & the lid mount hook for hanging the lid when while open should catch better since you can really see it unless you put your face near the heat. Dream item: solid bottom triangle support for better/additional storage instead of just wires.
Results.Title: Almost perfect

Results.ReviewText: Second one of these- first one lasted 20+ years- left out in the weather.  Withstood it without apparent effect until got caught in overspray of watering system for the last 3 years.  Water was getting directly on, and soaking the vent mechanism on the bottom of the kettle.  With predictable rust results, and eventual seizing up of the air and ash removal system.  Otherwise- the 20 year old grill would still be in use.  Oh yes- the control of modes of grilling, and smoking, and temp are superior... making this a great choice for the money.
Results.Title: Lasts Forever

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Excellent customer service. Versatile grill
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: The build quality is excellent. Made in the USA is a major selling point. The only thing I'd change is the location of the thermometer for smoking.
Results.Title: Great addition to the fleet.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for being a long-time Weber fan. We are sorry to learn that you are disappointed with your new Weber Original Kettle Premium Grill. That is not what we expect to hear!

We stand by the quality of our products and back them with a comprehensive warranty. Your satisfaction is our main priority, and we will not be satisfied until you are!

New charcoal kettle grills will have a slightly looser seal than a used model because it has not yet been seasoned by use. However, in all of our testing, we have never found evidence to suggest this temporary difference will affect your grilling results.

We want to know more about your grill's lid and offer further assistance. Please look for an email from our Care team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Had a performer for at least 15 years. Finally had to replace it and decided to save some money and bought this one. Big mistake! This one the lid will not seal! Very flimsy and lower to the ground! Weber was the go to grill for grilling and smoking not with this one. I regret not getting another performer.

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber kettle years ago and recently saw Chuds BBQ and his Weber kettle Series on YouTube and had to have another and it’s been great.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent all purpose grill and smoker. I’ve done all manner of chicken, beef Dino ribs, pork ribs, pulled pork, cedar plank salmon and veggies. This grill is an excellent value and can produce gourmet food. Everyone should own one.
Results.Title: Happy customer

Results.ReviewText: It’s a good and sturdy product. Still getting use to how to use it but there are great YouTube videos for ideas.
Results.Title: Good products

I had to purchase some upgraded items to make it the perfect kettle, but still by far the best one on the market.  

4 starts = thermostat is on the wrong spot….should be closer to the grate
…grate is thinner and needs upgrading.
Results.Title: Almost great

Results.ReviewText: I'm hesitant to give anything five stars: that should be reserved for the truly exemplary, examples of genius of design, etc. Let's call it 4½ stars, however. I'm particularly impressed with the ability to smother a fire simply by closing the lid and vents: that's a fairly air-restrictive design that permits unburned charcoal to be used again. Essentially, it lives up to Weber's reputation, which pretty much tells you what you might want to know.
Results.Title: Matches the Weber reputation

Results.ReviewText: Great gill only things I would change is moving the thermometer and maybe adding a hing for the lid.

Get one!

Results.ReviewText: Of all the grills I own, the Weber kettle is the most versatile!

Results.ReviewText: Have used my new Weber Kettle twice in the last month since I purchased it and I love it. Have smoked brisket burgers and a meatloaf and both came out amazing! Thermometer seems to be accurate and it was easy enough to assemble. Couldn't be happier!
Results.Title: Love My New Weber Kettle Premium Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Worth the money.  The Weber community is awesome.  Lots of grilling ideas
Results.Title: 22” kettle grill

Results.ReviewText:
My husband was a little skeptical, but decided to trust my usual thorough research. He is VERY happy with this grill. He did not know how to grill when we first met, but I helped out, and introduced him to the instant-read thermometer. Every piece of meat off the grill is wonderful!

For this grill, he loves that it is a bit larger than our last one, much better quality, and he says that the ash vents really are helpful for getting the coals moving fast. He does not use a starter chimney and does not appear to need one.

We had an excellent tri-tip for dinner tonight. More yumminess!

And of course, the ash-catcher is so convenient!

Thanks, Weber!
Results.Title: Very Happy With This Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill with solid construction. Assembly as a little tough due to tight tolerances and awkward balancing needed for the wheels. The lid hook is great and convenient. Cleaning is very simple and efficient. Could not be happier to have this classic on my patio.
Results.Title: Classic Performance from a Classic Name

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po

Results.ReviewText: Love using this grill, especially with the rapid starter chimney!
Results.Title: 22” Kettle Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText:
So far so good... great to have a charcoal bbq back!

TT
Results.Title: Great to have a charcoal Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Our recent purchase of a new Webber Kettle Grill replaces a 10+ year old Weber Kettle Grill that was still in good condition, but we decided to upgrade to the same newer model.  Over a decade of use, our Weber grill has stood the test of time.  The grill paint remained the same; weather did not deteriorate the grill, and the appearance remained the same high quality as when we purchased the original grill.
Results.Title: Weber Excellence

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
